chapter.doc: The chapter the night is in (1 to 5). Set by scripts/chapters.js; read by scripts/cast.js to place the characters and by P3's clue logic.

interviews.doc: How many of the four chapter 2 interviews were held. Added to by ch2_tobias, ch2_haas, ch2_lucian and ch2_mara; chapter 2 ends at 3.

trust.doc: How much the household trusts the porter. Added to by kind choices (ch1_mara, ch2_haas, ch2_mara, ch3_mara, ch4_mara, ch4_haas, ch4_lucian); the 'quiet' ending needs 3, Haas gives his room key at 1.

ending.doc: The ending reached: dawn, quiet or long. Set by the last line of ch5_vale; read by scripts/chapters.js, which shows the ending screen.

storm_over.doc: The storm has stopped and the front door can be opened. Set by the chapter 5 entry; read by the front door and P3.

intro_seen.doc: The opening cut-scene has played. Set by the cut-scene player (P4).

vale_missing.doc: The porter knows Dr. Vale is missing. Set by ch1_hedda; ends chapter 1.

know_oil.doc: Clue: Dr. Vale took a lantern and lamp oil to the cellar. Set by ch2_tobias and ch4_tobias; read by ch3_tobias.

know_cellar.doc: Clue: the cellar goes back further than its shelves. Set by ch2_haas and by the chapter 4 entry; P3 reads it to hint at the wine rack.

know_page.doc: Clue: Dr. Vale came for a missing survey page. Set by ch2_lucian.

know_argument.doc: Clue: Mara and Dr. Vale quarrelled at supper. Set by ch2_mara.

hedda_letter.doc: Hedda owns up to the torn letter. Set by ch3_hedda (when shown the letter) and ch4_hedda; read by ch5_lucian.

survey_known.doc: The porter understands the boundary stones and page forty. Set by ch3_mara (library) or ch3_lucian (room B); the 'dawn' ending needs it.

adit_known.doc: Haas has admitted the adit behind the third wine shelf. Set by ch4_haas.

adit_open.doc: The adit is open. Set by ch4_haas when the porter opens it with the lantern and the lamp oil.

vale_found.doc: Dr. Vale was brought out of the adit. Set by ch4_haas; ends chapter 4.

page_recovered.doc: Page forty of the survey is in the porter's hands. Set by ch4_haas.

mara_hurt.doc: The porter accused Mara of wanting Dr. Vale gone. Set by ch2_mara; colour for P4.

mara_kind.doc: The porter asked Mara how she was in the library. Set by ch3_mara so the kindness earns trust once.

haas_room.doc: Haas lent the key to room D. Set by ch3_haas.

cellar_box_taken.doc: The library key was taken from the cellar crate. Set by the item box p_cellar_box.

lantern_taken.doc: The cellar lantern was taken from the nook crate. Set by the item box p_lantern_box.

ledger_taken.doc: The guest ledger was taken from the library. Set by the item box p_ledger_box.

kitchen_box_taken.doc: The lamp oil was taken from the kitchen box. Set by the item box p_kitchen_box.

letter_taken.doc: The torn letter was taken from room B. Set by the item box p_letter_box.

test_box_taken.doc: The test room's key box was emptied. Set by the item box in the test room.

A door the porter opened: open.<door id>, set by scripts/interactable.js. Chapter 3 ends on open.guest_door_c.
A conversation held once in a chapter: talked.<character>.<chapter>. Set by the story data so a repeat gives the short 'again' line.

adit_descent.doc: The porter lights the lantern and goes down the adit behind the third wine shelf. Played by P4.

adit_rescue.doc: The porter brings Dr. Vale up the steps into the lamplight. Played by P4.
